---
title: "Instacart Shopping Dashboard"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: scroll
---


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)
library(flexdashboard)
```


Data Overview:

This dashboard explores purchasing patterns in the Instacart dataset from the p8105.datasets package. The analysis focuses on product purchase frequency and reorder behavior across grocery aisles and departments.

To reduce the complexity of the dataset, purchase records were aggregated by department and aisle. Only aisles with at least 100 purchase records were retained. The bar chart further focuses on the 12 aisles with the highest purchase counts.
```{r data, include=FALSE}
data("instacart")

aisle_summary =
  instacart |>
  group_by(department, aisle) |>
  summarize(
    n_products = n(),
    reorder_rate = mean(reordered == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(n_products >= 100)

top_aisles =
  aisle_summary |>
  slice_max(n_products, n = 12)
```

Row
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Most Popular Grocery Aisles
This bar chart displays the 12 aisles with the highest number of purchase records. Longer bars indicate greater purchase frequency. The chart highlights which grocery categories contribute most to the observed shopping activity.
```{r bar_plot}
top_aisles |>
  arrange(n_products) |>
  mutate(aisle = factor(aisle, levels = aisle)) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~n_products,
    y = ~aisle,
    type = "bar",
    orientation = "h"
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Number of Purchased Products"),
    yaxis = list(title = "")
  )
```

Row
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Purchase Frequency vs. Reorder Rate
Each point represents a grocery aisle. The horizontal axis shows its total number of purchase records, while the vertical axis represents the proportion of purchases marked as reordered. Hovering over a point reveals the corresponding aisle.

```{r scatter_plot}
aisle_summary |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~n_products,
    y = ~reorder_rate,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "markers",
    text = ~aisle,
    hovertemplate = paste(
      "%{text}",
      "<br>Products: %{x}",
      "<br>Reorder rate: %{y:.1%}",
      "<extra></extra>"
    )
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Number of Purchased Products"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Reorder Rate",
                 tickformat = ".0%")
  )
```
Row
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Reorder Rates by Department
This box plot compares the distributions of aisle-level reorder rates across grocery departments. Each box summarizes the variation in reorder rates among aisles within the same department, allowing comparisons of their medians and spread.

```{r box_plot}
aisle_summary |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~department,
    y = ~reorder_rate,
    type = "box",
    color = ~department,
    showlegend = FALSE
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Department"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Aisle Reorder Rate",
                 tickformat = ".0%")
  )
```
